cards.answer: Rakan is a mobile support who dashes in to knock enemies up, charms enemies he touches, and dashes to allies to shield them. He deals magic damage, with damage, healing and shields that scale with AP.
cards.counterplay: Spread out, avoid his approach, and watch nearby allies he can dash to.

cards.answer: Fey Feathers periodically gives Rakan a shield. An unbroken shield restores itself out of combat, while his attacks and ability hits against enemy champions shorten its cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Account for his shield before committing damage, and avoid letting him trade freely.

cards.answer: Gleaming Quill fires a feather that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit. Hitting a champion or epic monster prepares a heal for Rakan and nearby allies; the heal triggers after a delay or earlier when an allied champion comes close.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the feather or use minions to block it, and account for the heal after a qualifying hit.

facts.claim: Hitting a champion or epic monster prepares a heal for Rakan and nearby allies; the heal triggers after a delay or earlier when an allied champion comes close.

cards.priority_reason: Avoiding the projectile limits both poke and healing access.

cards.answer: Grand Entrance dashes to a location, then deals magic damage and knocks up nearby enemies after a brief delay. Immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control can interrupt the dash.
cards.counterplay: Move away from his landing area, spread out, or try to interrupt his dash with crowd control.

citations.quote: Rakan dashes to the target location. After a brief delay, he deals magic damage and briefly knocks up nearby enemies.

facts.claim: Grand Entrance dashes to a location, then deals magic damage and knocks up nearby enemies after a brief delay.

facts.claim: Immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control can interrupt the dash.

cards.priority_reason: His area knockup is a major engage threat with a brief opportunity to react.

cards.answer: Battle Dance shields an allied champion and dashes Rakan to them, with a free recast available briefly afterward. It has increased range when targeting Xayah. Immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control can interrupt the dash.
cards.counterplay: Watch his allies as escape routes, respect his reach toward Xayah, and try to interrupt his dash.

cards.answer: The Quickness gives Rakan movement speed and makes contact with enemies deal magic damage, charm and slow them. Touching an enemy champion extends its duration, and his initial enemy champion contact grants an extra burst of movement speed. The same enemy cannot be affected again during that activation.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance and spread out to make it harder for him to sweep through your team.
